subject: Deal signal cordon and recovery playbook
messages:
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@acuityhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: AcuityHealth Contracts <contracts@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: SOW + timeline pressure (need updated commit)

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Sharing the latest internal ask — procurement needs an executed SOW and purchase order by 06 May to keep our integration window and Q3 launch. I attached the latest SOW (minor edits from our legal). We are flagged as high priority on their side but the finance owners are pushing back unless we can confirm committed pricing and delivery milestones.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can hold the quoted pricing and existing on-prem windows (no change).
- If there is any flexibility on invoice timing (they asked about Net 60 but procurement prefers Net 30).

We are ready to sign once legal confirms the SOW and your team confirms the capacity and start date. Appreciate a quick confirmation so I can escalate internally.

Attachment: SOW_Acuity_v3.pdf (SOW PDF, 48KB)

Thanks,
Tom Hayes
Director of Integrations
AcuityHealth

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@acuityhealth.com>, AcuityHealth Contracts <contracts@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW + timeline pressure (need updated commit)

Internal note before we reply to Tom (keeping him in the loop):

TL;DR — this is a time-sensitive close. We need a quick red/yellow/green triage and an owner for each mitigation. I propose we push a conservative mutual action plan to Acuity and request a 2-week sign-off window.

Immediate asks (owners and ETA):
- Marissa: confirm committed pricing and whether Finance can accept Net 60 or requires Net 30. Update forecast numbers in the shared sheet. (Owner: marissa_cole; ETA: EOD today)
- Grace: capacity check for Dedicated pool start date and any uplift needed to guarantee Q3 launch. Call out any chargeable burst/priority fees. (Owner: grace_oconnor; ETA: tomorrow 11:00am PT)
- Rishi: prep a short exception request for SLA/start date language if procurement redlines the SLA. Also run through approval path for any one-off credit requests. (Owner: rishi_malhotra; ETA: tomorrow EOD)

Proposed risk table (quick):
- RED: SOW redlines on data residency or SLA that require product changes or private deployment. Impact: >3 week slip.
- YELLOW: Invoice/terms negotiation (Net 30 vs Net 60) or minor payment milestone adjustments. Impact: 1–2 week procurement delay.
- GREEN: Legal language edits that don't affect delivery or pricing, or internal signature sequencing. Impact: minimal.

Put the near-term forecast numbers into Acuity_forecast_input.xlsx (I created a tab for committed vs best-case). Marissa — please add the updated expected ARR and whether we should keep this in commit.

I'll draft the external Mutual Action Plan after we have the triage. When we respond to Tom, we'll include the SOW, confirm pricing, and offer a fallback: provisional start date contingent on PO, with an option to head-start onboarding as a paid pilot if they need an earlier runway.

Logan
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW + timeline pressure (need updated commit)

Quick update from Finance / Deal Desk after a fast sync with procurement today: we can hold pricing as quoted if the PO is submitted by 06 May and the payment terms are Net 45 (compromise). Net 60 requires a 2% upfront prepay or a revenue holdback that will affect how we recognize ARR this quarter.

Actions I've taken:
- Updated Acuity_forecast_input.xlsx: set committed ARR = $360,000 (conservative) and best-case ARR = $395,000. See tab "Logan_Acuity_commit".
- Marked deal stage as Commit (but flagged for legal sign-off).
- Uploaded a note to the HubSpot deal with the Net45 compromise and Finance conditional language. Link: https://hubspot.company/deal/ACQ-2024-078

Recommendation: present the Net45 compromise to Acuity and offer a Net60 with a 2% prepay as an alternative only if they cannot approve within their 06 May PO deadline. That keeps this in Commit and supports our Q3 forecast while limiting revenue recognition pain.

Attachments: Acuity_forecast_input.xlsx (workbook)

Marissa
Head of Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

On Mon, 26 Apr 2027 at 09:02 Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Internal note before we reply to Tom (keeping him in the loop):
> ...

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, AcuityHealth Contracts <contracts@acuityhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOW + timeline pressure (need updated commit)

Tom — thanks for the heads up and for sending the SOW. We've done a fast internal triage and have a short mutual action plan to keep the timeline intact while addressing procurement's asks.

Mutual Action Plan (short):
1) Redwood confirms quoted pricing in SOW as-is. We can accept a PO by 06 May to hold price and schedule.
2) Payment terms: Redwood Finance proposes Net45 as the standard compromise. If Acuity requires Net60, we can offer Net60 with a 2% prepayment option to preserve Q3 recognition (Marissa has the details).
3) Capacity/start: Redwood can provision the Dedicated pool to meet the proposed start date contingent on PO submission. Grace will confirm the exact earliest ramp date by EOD tomorrow.
4) Legal/SOW: we will accept minor language edits that do not materially change delivery or data residency. If procurement requests changes that modify delivery timelines or data controls, we will need to re-evaluate (this would be a RED signal).

Next steps:
- Marissa to send the updated forecast numbers and the Net45 compromise wording to your procurement team (cc'd).
- Grace to confirm ramp/start date and any chargeable priority fees by EOD tomorrow.
- I will schedule a 30-minute sync Thursday to finalize and get signatures onto the SOW once procurement confirms PO timing.

Please reply if the Net45 compromise is acceptable or if procurement prefers to explore the Net60 + 2% prepay route. We want to keep this in the commit forecast for Q3 and avoid any slippage.

Best,
Logan Wright
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
